issues.description: Problem statement for Aufgabe 10 asks for the IDs of Radwege, but the solution selects Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name. This mismatch between requested attribute (ID) and the attribute returned by the solution will confuse students about what to output and may cause tests to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the solution to select the Radweg ID column instead of the name. For example, change the SELECT clause to return the appropriate ID column from Radweg_zu_Gemeinde (e.g. SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id or SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.id) while keeping the same WHERE condition for the two Regierungsbezirke.

issues.description: Problem statement asks for the IDs of Radwege (task 10), but the solution returns Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name. This mismatches the conceptual entity: the requested 'ID' is not the same identifier as a 'name' field. Students following the problem will look for an ID column but the solution (and thus expected mapping) uses 'name', creating confusion about which column represents the Radweg identifier.
issues.suggestedFix: Align identifiers: either modify the solution to select the Radweg ID column (for example SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id or SELECT Radweg.id depending on schema) and keep the WHERE/join logic, or change the problem statement to request Radweg names if the intention was to return names. Prefer returning the explicit ID column named in the schema to match the task description.
